proven: Harness-provided raw parsing plus closed branch selection stabilized the five-case component admission matrix.
The resident selected the exact opaque branch ids for known full pointer, unknown object/version, unknown operator, unknown version, and unknown-all cases.
Full canonical pointer admission occurred only when operator, object class, and object version ref were all registry-backed.
Unknown operator, object, and version cases did not nearest-repair to CREATE, ui.menu, ui.menu@v1, or CREATE ui.menu@v1.
The Probe 017 mini nearest-operator component leak and Probe 018 resident-authored raw parse ambiguity did not recur.
not_proven: Natural hidden-route semantic binding without explicit parsed candidates.
Generalization across a large operator/class/version registry.
Branch selection without explicit D-law in the prompt.
Resident-owned canonical materialization or routing status authority.
architecture_read: The harness should parse raw pointer fields, provide closed semantic branch choices, materialize canonical fields from selected branch ids, and compute routing status. The resident is reliable here as a branch selector and uncertainty explainer, not as the authority for parsing or canonical materialization.
recommended_next_probe: Probe 020 should remove semantic labels from branch explanations or use a larger mixed registry to test whether the resident follows registry evidence and D-law rather than memorizing simple single-entry cases.
